Sky Serpent version 1.0

Privacy policy

Most of your game stays on your phone. Your coins, lives, helmets and settings are saved on this device, and uninstalling the game deletes them. Your level wins are also saved to our server (see Cloud save below).

Payments are handled by Google Play. The game never sees your card or billing details.

Purchase records. To deliver and restore purchases, the game uses RevenueCat, a purchase service. It receives your purchase history and a random ID the app creates. It does not receive your name or email. Data is sent encrypted (HTTPS).

Not collected: contacts, photos, location or messages, and no name or email unless you claim a prize. The game has no chat and no pop-up ads.

Cloud save and challenges. Your level progress is saved to our server under a random ID so only real climbs count. If you claim a challenge prize, we also store your name, email and state, used only to verify your win and send your prize. Delete it all anytime: Settings > Delete my data.

Optional ads. Reward videos come from Google AdMob and only play when you tap to watch one. Google may use your advertising ID and IP address to show and measure them. In some regions you are asked for consent first and can change it in Settings.

Notifications. If you turn them on, reminders are scheduled on your phone itself. Nothing is sent to a server.

Keeping and deleting data. Purchase records are kept so you can restore your purchases. To have your purchase record or your cloud save deleted without the app, email and it will be done within 30 days.

Children. The game is not directed at children under 13.
